name: How long does a typical whole home remodel take in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole home remodel take in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole home remodel varies significantly based on the scope, size of the home, and complexity of structural changes. Generally, projects can take anywhere from 6 to 18 months, or even longer for very extensive undertakings. This includes design, permitting, demolition, construction, and finishing phases. Factors like material lead times, inspection schedules, and unforeseen conditions can also influence the timeline. We work to establish realistic timelines and keep you informed throughout the process.
